supportEnvelope.basis: Manually selected visible outer masonry footing extrema and frontmost contact. Logical placement envelope includes compact entrance threshold; rear corner is hidden and only inferred by parallelogram closure. Approximately +/-6 px; not a four-corner physical camera measurement.

W.basis: Visible straight upper roof parapet edge toward lower right; manually selected endpoints, approximately +/-3 px.

D.basis: Visible straight upper roof parapet edge toward upper right; D reported with increasing source x, approximately +/-3 px.

heightReference.basis: Vertical architectural body ruler; excludes roof machinery and antennae. Same source x. Main body cornice is visible; ground plane reference is inferred where upper setbacks obscure the vertical projection. Approximate visual height reference, +/-12 px, not a physical storey measurement.

notes: Source RGBA PNG is copied byte-for-byte; no pixel editing, recoloring, cropping or alpha thresholding was applied.
Crop is the half-open absolute bbox of alpha>8; runtime display cache may suppress very low alpha by the existing shared rule.
This is render-time direction/scale calibration. Unmeasured roof details and hidden geometry are not claimed to share an exact physical orthographic camera.
Ground envelope, not full transparent image or roof silhouette, determines centering and at least 0.1-cell setback.
A single corrective imagegen pass narrowed the whole ground plan and removed exterior ground planters/paving; the first draft was rejected because footprint-limited height was below H3.
